transforms: Diagnostic IPs, hostnames, private paths and experiment tags are consistently remapped.
Numeric JSON, client gzip files and trace JSONL are byte-for-byte unchanged, including compression. Their original export hashes are retained and checked.
Frozen runtime, tested core and executed tool source content is unchanged; archived code is never executed by the verifier.
Frozen committed source retains an existing static private-network address fixture in tests/test_cluster_address.py; run-specific endpoint diagnostics are remapped.
scope: Three correlated off/on windows per group. Same-process default-adaptive observation; load shares Follower 3. Percentiles are medians of window percentiles, not pooled percentiles. Leader-thread overlap is request-weighted wall time, not device latency or system utilization; excludes follower I/O and uninstrumented phases.
